title: ERT Medic: Rail Spot 2 Entry — Field Confirmation

lines.text: Control, this is Medic 3 from the ERT. We are at the perimeter of Rail Spot 2. The vapor is thick, and the hand valve HV-312 is still open. The ESD-310 status on the DeltaV HMI still shows closed, but the field sees the release continuing. The wind is pushing the cloud toward Corbin Falls Elementary School. We are starting entry procedures now.
Medic 3, copy. Maintain position and report when you reach the isolation point. Confirm SCBA and Level A suit integrity.
Roger, Control. We are proceeding to HV-312 now. Visual confirmation of valve open — no movement on the HMI. Proceeding to manual isolation.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the field-screens discrepancy and escalates the threat to the school. Watch for the Operations Section Chief to order a field watch on HV-312 and the Incident Commander to activate CAER-Text.
